description: Compare 2 to 4 pitches side by side: ask, stage, sector, HQ region, traction note, green flags, public score, dimension scores (keyed callers, public scores only) and compact decision aggregates (likes vs passes, average rating, top pass reasons; investor API keys only, else reason key_required; each withheld below 5 distinct signed-in users, counts as bands; the likes-vs-passes block may be withheld with reason hidden_pending_review, and the team-related pass reasons are withheld pending review). Use when: an investor is choosing between shortlisted pitches. Do not use for: more than 4 pitches (run pitchspark_search_pitches_v3 sorted by score instead), full pitch text (pitchspark_get_pitch_v2). All ids must be distinct and resolvable: any id that is missing, not public or opted out answers NOT_FOUND for the whole call, and nothing is counted. The whole comparison is delivered or nothing is (a spent allowance answers RATE_LIMITED). Returns {"pitches":[...in the order given], "attribution"}. Each pitch this tool returns counts 1 against the daily pitch allowance (the one allowance every pitch tool shares), or 0 when the same API key (without a key, the same connection) already got that pitch today. Calls are logged, and each pitch returned is counted as a view.
